source: Why I stopped deadlifting at 40, YouTube 9nfvwfo52Z0 (Zeeshan video 3 SRT)

cover.headline:
I quit deadlifts.
[y]4 lifts instead.[/y]
Safer at 40.

cutout.alt: Dan in black trunks and glasses

moves.name: Rear delt fly

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan bent over with dumbbells out to his sides

cues: Move in an arc. Don't row it.
Squeeze a pencil between your shoulder blades.

moves.name: T-bar row

image.placeholder: Gym, side angle: Dan on the T-bar row machine with a wide grip, weight pulled to his lower chest, back flat

cues: Load the T-bar machine and row it back.
Wide grip for width, not thickness.
Don't jerk it up with your lower back.

moves.name: Lat pulldown

image.placeholder: Gym, front three-quarter angle: Dan doing wide-grip lat pulldowns, bar pulled to his upper chest, elbows driven down

cues: Wide builds the wings of a V-taper.

moves.name: Leg press

image.placeholder: Gym, side angle: Dan on the leg press at the bottom of a rep, knees near 90 degrees, safety stops visible, lower back flat on the pad

cues: Push back up through your heels.

recap.title: Screenshot this.
recap.note: 1 warm-up set of 12 to 15, then 2 hard sets of 6 to 10.
recap.text: Stay injury free and you build more muscle over the years. Tag a friend over 40 who still deadlifts.
